name: An iterator retains its source until exhaustion, then releases it

input.source_text: module M { public fun run() -> Array { let a = [1]; let base = a.share_count(); mut it = a.iterator(); let held = a.share_count(); let first = it.next(); let retained = a.share_count(); let done = it.next() == Iteration.done; let after = a.share_count(); [held > base, retained > base, done, after == base] } } M.run()

applicability.reason: Retention and release are ownership facts, observed through the share count rather than by forcing a collection.
